title: Fundamentals of Computer Programming with C#
subtitle: Programming Principles, Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structures
author: Svetlin Nakov, Veselin Kolev, Nakov's Team
description: A large, thorough introduction to programming using C#. Covers the language and .NET from first principles, then data structures, algorithms, recursion, OOP, exception handling, and writing high-quality code, with hundreds of worked examples and exercises.
